df = pd.read_csv("cleaned_ecommerce_dataset-1.csv")

Sub plots¶

01.Total Amount,Session Duration,Quantity,Review Score, Discount,Price by age¶

In [5]:
fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(12, 12))
colors = ['blue', 'green', 'red', 'purple', 'orange', 'brown']

df_agg = df.groupby('age')['totalamount'].mean().reset_index().sort_values('age')
axes[0, 0].plot(df_agg['age'], df_agg['totalamount'], color=colors[0])
axes[0, 0].set_title("Avg Total Amount by Age")
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel("Age")
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel("Total Amount")

df_agg = df.groupby('age')['sessionduration'].mean().reset_index().sort_values('age')
axes[0, 1].plot(df_agg['age'], df_agg['sessionduration'], color=colors[1])
axes[0, 1].set_title("Avg Session Duration by Age")
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel("Age")
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel("Duration")

df_agg = df.groupby('age')['quantity'].mean().reset_index().sort_values('age')
axes[1, 0].plot(df_agg['age'], df_agg['quantity'], color=colors[2])
axes[1, 0].set_title("Avg Quantity by Age")
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel("Age")
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel("Quantity")

df_agg = df.groupby('age')['reviewscore'].mean().reset_index().sort_values('age')
axes[1, 1].plot(df_agg['age'], df_agg['reviewscore'], color=colors[3])
axes[1, 1].set_title("Avg Review Score by Age")
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel("Age")
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel("Review Score")

df_agg = df.groupby('age')['discountrate'].mean().reset_index().sort_values('age')
axes[2, 0].plot(df_agg['age'], df_agg['discountrate'], color=colors[4])
axes[2, 0].set_title("Avg Discount Rate by Age")
axes[2, 0].set_xlabel("Age")
axes[2, 0].set_ylabel("Discount Rate")

df_agg = df.groupby('age')['price'].mean().reset_index().sort_values('age')
axes[2, 1].plot(df_agg['age'], df_agg['price'], color=colors[5])
axes[2, 1].set_title("Avg Price by Age")
axes[2, 1].set_xlabel("Age")
axes[2, 1].set_ylabel("Price")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

02.Total Sales over Time¶

In [6]:
df['purchasedate'] = pd.to_datetime(df['purchasedate'], errors='coerce')
df = df.dropna(subset=['purchasedate', 'totalamount'])
df = df.sort_values('purchasedate')

df_grouped = df.groupby('purchasedate')['totalamount'].sum().reset_index()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1, figsize=(12, 6))

ax.plot(
    df_grouped['purchasedate'],
    df_grouped['totalamount'],
    linestyle='-'
)

ax.set_xlabel('Purchase Date')
ax.set_ylabel('Total Amount')
ax.set_title('Total Sales Over Time')
ax.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax.grid(True)

fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()

01. Analysis of Customer Behavior, Engagement, and Spending Patterns by Age¶

In [7]:
from mpl_toolkits.axes_grid1.inset_locator import inset_axes
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))

ax = axes[0, 0]
age_data = df.groupby('age')['totalamount'].mean().reset_index()
ax.plot(age_data['age'], age_data['totalamount'], color='red')
ax.set_title('Mean Total Amount by Age')
ax.set_xlabel('Age')
ax.set_ylabel('Total Amount')

axins = inset_axes(ax, width="40%", height="40%", loc=1)
sample = df.sample(200)
axins.scatter(sample['price'], sample['quantity'], c=sample['price'], cmap='Blues', alpha=0.4)
axins.set_xticks([]); axins.set_yticks([])
axins.set_title('Price vs Quantity', fontsize=10)

ax = axes[0, 1]
age_data = df.groupby('age')['sessionduration'].mean().reset_index()
ax.plot(age_data['age'], age_data['sessionduration'], color='blue', linestyle='-.')
ax.set_title('Average Session Duration by Age')
ax.set_xlabel('Age')
ax.set_ylabel('Duration (Min)')

axins = inset_axes(ax, width="40%", height="40%", loc=2)
sample = df.sample(200)
axins.scatter(sample['discountrate'], sample['totalamount'], c=sample['totalamount'], cmap='Greens', alpha=0.3)
axins.set_xticks([]); axins.set_yticks([])
axins.set_title('Discount vs Total Amount', fontsize=10)

ax = axes[1, 0]
age_data = df.groupby('age')['reviewscore'].mean().reset_index()
ax.plot(age_data['age'], age_data['reviewscore'], color='purple')
ax.set_title('Average Review Score by Age')

07.Mean Total Amount by Purchase Month¶

In [9]:
df['purchasedate'] = pd.to_datetime(df['purchasedate'], errors='coerce')
df = df.dropna(subset=['purchasedate'])
date_data = df.groupby(df['purchasedate'].dt.to_period('M'))['totalamount'].mean().reset_index()
date_data['purchasedate'] = date_data['purchasedate'].dt.to_timestamp()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1, figsize=[10, 6])

plt.tight_layout()

ax.plot(date_data['purchasedate'], date_data['totalamount'], 
        label='Mean Total Amount', color='red', marker='o')
ax.set_title('Main: Mean Total Amount Trend by Purchase Month')
ax.set_xlabel('Date')
ax.set_ylabel('Mean Total Amount')
ax.legend()
ax.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)

axins = inset_axes(ax, width="40%", height="40%", loc=1, borderpad=3)
sample = df.sample(200, random_state=42)
x = sample['price']
y = sample['quantity']

axins.scatter(x, y, c=x*0.01, s=y*50, alpha=0.4, cmap='Blues')
axins.set_xlabel('Price')
axins.set_ylabel('Qty')
axins.set_title('Price vs Quantity')

for axi in [axins]:
    axi.tick_params(labelleft=False, labelbottom=False)

plt.show()

Scatter Plots¶

01. Analysis of Age vs. Total Amount by gender, Discount Rate vs Avg Review Score, Age vs Session Duration by Gender, Log Price vs Log Total Amount and Total Quantity Sold Over Time¶

In [4]:
fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(16, 18))
axes = axes.flatten() 

grouped1 = df.groupby(['age', 'gender'])['totalamount'].mean().reset_index()
for g in grouped1['gender'].unique():
    subset = grouped1[grouped1['gender'] == g]
    axes[0].plot(subset['age'], subset['totalamount'], '-o', label=g, markersize=6)
axes[0].set_title("Age vs Total Amount by Gender")
axes[0].set_xlabel("Age")
axes[0].set_ylabel("Average Total Amount")
axes[0].legend()
axes[0].grid(True)

df['discount_bin'] = pd.cut(df['discountrate'], bins=10)
grouped2 = df.groupby('discount_bin', observed=True)['reviewscore'].mean().reset_index()
axes[1].scatter(range(len(grouped2)), grouped2['reviewscore'], marker='o', 
                color='orange', s=100, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
axes[1].set_title("Discount Rate vs Avg Review Score")
axes[1].set_xlabel("Discount Rate (Binned)")
axes[1].set_ylabel("Average Review Score")
axes[1].set_xticks(range(len(grouped2)))
axes[1].set_xticklabels(grouped2['discount_bin'], rotation=45)
axes[1].grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.4)

grouped3 = df.groupby(['age', 'gender'])['sessionduration'].mean().reset_index()
for g in grouped3['gender'].unique():
    subset = grouped3[grouped3['gender'] == g]
    axes[2].plot(subset['age'], subset['sessionduration'], '-o', label=g, markersize=6)
axes[2].set_title("Age vs Session Duration by Gender")
axes[2].set_xlabel("Age")
axes[2].set_ylabel("Avg Session Duration (Min)")
axes[2].legend()
axes[2].grid(True)

axes[3].scatter(df.log_price, df.log_totalamount, marker='o', color='purple', 
                s=20, alpha=0.3, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.3)
axes[3].set_title("Log Price vs Log Total Amount")
axes[3].set_xlabel("Log Price")
axes[3].set_ylabel("Log Total Amount")
axes[3].grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.4)

df['purchasedate'] = pd.to_datetime(df['purchasedate'], errors='coerce')
df_temp = df.dropna(subset=['purchasedate', 'quantity']).sort_values('purchasedate')
df_qty = df_temp.groupby('purchasedate')['quantity'].sum().reset_index()

axes[4].scatter(df_qty['purchasedate'], df_qty['quantity'], color='teal')
axes[4].set_title('Total Quantity Sold Over Time')
axes[4].set_xlabel('Purchase Date')
axes[4].set_ylabel('Total Quantity Sold')
axes[4].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
axes[4].grid(True)

axes[5].axis('off')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

Bubble chart¶

01. Analysis of Age vs. Total Amount, Discount Rate Effect, Age vs Session Duration, Discount vs Review Score, Age vs Spending and Price vs Satisfaction¶

In [17]:
fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(18, 25))
axes = axes.flatten()  

grouped1 = df.groupby(['age', 'gender']).agg({
    'totalamount': 'mean', 'reviewscore': 'mean', 'quantity': 'sum'
}).reset_index()
for gender in grouped1['gender'].unique():
    subset = grouped1[grouped1['gender'] == gender]
    sizes = subset['quantity'] / subset['quantity'].max() * 800
    sc1 = axes[0].scatter(subset['age'], subset['totalamount'], c=subset['reviewscore'], 
                          s=sizes, alpha=0.6, label=f"Gender {gender}", cmap='Blues')
fig.colorbar(sc1, ax=axes[0], label='Avg Review Score')
axes[0].set_title("Age vs Avg Total Amount by Gender")
axes[0].set_xlabel("Age")
axes[0].set_ylabel("Avg Total Amount")
axes[0].legend(title="Gender")

grouped2 = df.groupby('discountrate').agg({
    'sessionduration': 'mean', 'price': 'mean', 'quantity': 'sum'
}).reset_index()
sc2 = axes[1].scatter(grouped2['price'], grouped2['sessionduration'], 
                      c=grouped2['discountrate'], s=grouped2['quantity'] * 5, 
                      alpha=0.6, cmap='Greens')
fig.colorbar(sc2, ax=axes[1], label='Discount Rate')
axes[1].set_title("Grouped Bubble: Discount Rate Effect")
axes[1].set_xlabel("Avg Price")
axes[1].set_ylabel("Avg Session Duration")

grouped3 = df.groupby(['age', 'category']).agg({
    'sessionduration': 'mean', 'discountrate': 'mean'
}).reset_index()
sc3 = axes[2].scatter(grouped3['age'], grouped3['sessionduration'], 
                      c=pd.factorize(grouped3['category'])[0], 
                      s=grouped3['discountrate'] * 100, alpha=0.5, cmap='Reds')
fig.colorbar(sc3, ax=axes[2], label='Category (encoded)')
axes[2].set_title("Age vs Session Duration (by Category)")
axes[2].set_xlabel("Age")
axes[2].set_ylabel("Avg Session Duration")

grouped5 = df.groupby(['gender', 'devicetype']).agg({
    'discountrate': 'mean', 'reviewscore': 'mean', 'age': 'mean'
}).reset_index()
obj1 = pd.factorize(grouped5['gender'])[0] + pd.factorize(grouped5['devicetype'])[0]
sc5 = axes[3].scatter(grouped5['discountrate'], grouped5['reviewscore'], 
                      c=obj1, s=grouped5['age'] * 5, cmap='Blues', 
                      alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
fig.colorbar(sc5, ax=axes[3], label='Gender + Device (encoded)')
axes[3].set_title(" Discount vs Review Score")
axes[3].set_xlabel("Average Discount Rate")
axes[3].set_ylabel("Average Review Score")
axes[3].grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)

age_summary = df.groupby('age').agg({
    'totalamount': 'mean',
    'sessionduration': 'mean',
    'discountrate': 'mean'
}).reset_index()
sc_new1 = axes[4].scatter(
    x=age_summary['age'], 
    y=age_summary['totalamount'], 
    s=age_summary['sessionduration'] * 5, 
    c=age_summary['discountrate'], 
    cmap='plasma', alpha=0.6, edgecolors='w'
)
fig.colorbar(sc_new1, ax=axes[4], label='Avg Discount Rate')
axes[4].set_title("5. Age vs. Average Spending\n(Size=Session Duration, Color=Discount)")
axes[4].set_xlabel("Age")
axes[4].set_ylabel("Avg Total Amount ($)")

df['price_bin'] = pd.cut(df['price'], bins=25)
price_summary = df.groupby('price_bin', observed=False).agg({
    'price': 'mean',
    'reviewscore': 'mean',
    'quantity': 'sum',
    'totalamount': 'sum'
}).dropna().reset_index()

sc_new2 = axes[5].scatter(
    x=price_summary['price'], 
    y=price_summary['reviewscore'], 
    s=price_summary['quantity'] * 0.08, 
    c=price_summary['totalamount'], 
    cmap='YlGnBu', alpha=0.7, edgecolors='k', linewidth=0.5
)
fig.colorbar(sc_new2, ax=axes[5], label='Total Revenue')
axes[5].set_title("6. Price vs. Review Score\n(Size=Quantity Sold, Color=Revenue)")
axes[5].set_xlabel("Average Price ($)")
axes[5].set_ylabel("Average Review Score")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

02.Avg Log Price vs Avg Log Total Amount¶

In [15]:
df['purchasedate'] = pd.to_datetime(df['purchasedate'], errors='coerce')
df = df.dropna(subset=['purchasedate'])
df['month'] = df['purchasedate'].dt.to_period('M').astype(str)

grouped = df.groupby('month').agg({
    'log_price': 'mean',
    'log_totalamount': 'mean',
    'quantity': 'sum'
}).reset_index().sort_values('month')

x = grouped['log_price']
y = grouped['log_totalamount']
obj1 = grouped['month']
obj2 = (grouped['quantity'] / grouped['quantity'].max()) * 1000 

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 7))
scatter = plt.scatter(x, y,
            c=range(len(obj1)), 
            s=obj2,
            cmap='Blues',
            alpha=0.6,
            edgecolors='black')

for i, txt in enumerate(obj1):
    plt.annotate(txt, (x[i], y[i]), fontsize=8, ha='center', va='center')

plt.colorbar(scatter, label='Time Progress (Months Index)')
plt.title("Time-Based Comparison: Avg Log Price vs Avg Log Total Amount")
plt.xlabel("Avg Log Price")
plt.ylabel("Avg Log Total Amount")
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

Line charts¶

01. Average Total Amount by Age, Average Session Duration by Age, Average Product Price by Age, Average Review Score by Age, Average Discount Rate by Age and Average Purchase Quantity by Age¶

In [18]:
fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(15, 18))
axes = axes.flatten()  

metrics = [
    ('totalamount', 'red', 'Average Total Amount by Age', 'Total Amount ($)'),
    ('sessionduration', 'blue', 'Average Session Duration by Age', 'Duration (Minutes)'),
    ('price', 'green', 'Average Product Price by Age', 'Price ($)'),
    ('reviewscore', 'orange', 'Average Review Score by Age', 'Score (1-5)'),
    ('discountrate', 'purple', 'Average Discount Rate by Age', 'Discount Rate'),
    ('quantity', 'brown', 'Average Quantity per Order by Age', 'Quantity')
]

for i, (column, color, title, ylabel) in enumerate(metrics):
    
    eds = df.groupby('age')[column].mean().reset_index()
    
    axes[i].plot(eds['age'], eds[column], color=color, marker='o', linestyle='-')
    
    axes[i].set_title(title, fontsize=14)
    axes[i].set_xlabel('Age')
    axes[i].set_ylabel(ylabel)
    axes[i].grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

Legends¶

01. Analysis of Total Amount by Age, Session Duration by Age, Price Comparison by Age, Review Scores by Age, Discount & Quantity and Engagement Overview¶

In [20]:
slcd = df.groupby('age').mean(numeric_only=True).reset_index()

fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(16, 20))
axes = axes.flatten()  

legend_style = dict(loc='lower center', frameon=True, ncol=3, borderpad=1, framealpha=0.1, shadow=True)

axes[0].plot(slcd['age'], slcd['totalamount'], '-g', label='Total Amount')
axes[0].plot(slcd['age'], slcd['log_totalamount'], ':b', label='Log Total')
axes[0].set_ylim(slcd['totalamount'].min() - 5, slcd['totalamount'].max() + 5)
axes[0].set_title('Total Amount Metrics')
axes[0].legend(**legend_style)

axes[1].plot(slcd['age'], slcd['sessionduration'], '-g', label='Session Duration')
axes[1].plot(slcd['age'], slcd['log_sessionduration'], ':b', label='Log Session')
axes[1].set_title('Session Duration Metrics')
axes[1].legend(**legend_style)

axes[2].plot(slcd['age'], slcd['price'], '-g', label='Unit Price')
axes[2].plot(slcd['age'], slcd['log_price'], ':b', label='Log Price')
axes[2].set_title('Price Metrics')
axes[2].legend(**legend_style)

axes[3].plot(slcd['age'], slcd['reviewscore'], '-.r', label='Review Score')
axes[3].set_ylim(0, 6)
axes[3].set_title('Review Score Analysis')
axes[3].legend(**legend_style)

axes[4].plot(slcd['age'], slcd['discountrate'], '-g', label='Discount Rate')
axes[4].plot(slcd['age'], slcd['quantity'], ':b', label='Quantity')
axes[4].set_title('Discount and Quantity Trends')
axes[4].legend(**legend_style)

axes[5].plot(slcd['age'], slcd['totalamount']/100, '-g', label='Spending/100')
axes[5].plot(slcd['age'], slcd['quantity'], ':b', label='Quantity')
axes[5].plot(slcd['age'], slcd['reviewscore'], '-.r', label='Review Score')
axes[5].set_title('Combined Engagement Metrics')
axes[5].legend(**legend_style)

for ax in axes:
    ax.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)
    ax.set_xlabel('Age')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

Color Maps¶

01. Analysis of Log Price vs. Review Score, Log Price vs. Log Total Amount and Spending Density over Time¶

In [22]:
import matplotlib.dates as mdates
In [24]:
df['purchasedate'] = pd.to_datetime(df['purchasedate'], errors='coerce')
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['purchasedate', 'totalamount'])
x_dates = mdates.date2num(df_clean['purchasedate'])

fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(12, 18))

im1 = axes[0].hist2d(df['log_price'], df['reviewscore'], bins=20, cmap='nipy_spectral')
fig.colorbar(im1[3], ax=axes[0], label='Concentration of Users')
axes[0].set_title('Log Price vs. Review Score Density', fontsize=14)
axes[0].set_xlabel('Log(Price)')
axes[0].set_ylabel('Review Score')

hb2 = axes[1].hexbin(df['log_price'], df['log_totalamount'], gridsize=25, cmap='turbo')
fig.colorbar(hb2, ax=axes[1], label='Density')
axes[1].set_title('Log Price vs. Log Total Amount', fontsize=14)
axes[1].set_xlabel('Log Price')
axes[1].set_ylabel('Log Total Amount')

hb3 = axes[2].hexbin(x_dates, df_clean['totalamount'], gridsize=20, cmap='magma')
fig.colorbar(hb3, ax=axes[2], label='Count of Records')

axes[2].xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter('%Y-%m-%d'))
axes[2].set_title('Spending Density Over Time', fontsize=14)
axes[2].set_xlabel('Purchase Date')
axes[2].set_ylabel('Total Amount')

plt.setp(axes[2].get_xticklabels(), rotation=30, ha='right')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
